propositions: Documentation policy must define audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, and correction method for eight distinct categories: tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence
Writing rules must be restored as non-binding authoring guidance without introducing deterministic validators, gates, or enforcement mechanisms that produce false positives
Documentation ownership pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md must reference the central policy and generated-artifacts catalog without describing guidance as a validator
Generated-artifact catalog descriptions for cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, and reviewer-prompt must match historical pre-F01 source verbatim
Ticket corrections must remain append-only events and ADR corrections must preserve decision substance through annotations or replacement ADRs
Protected forms including licenses, quotations, captures, generated outputs, ticket events, ADR substance, and technical syntax must be excluded from modification or deterministic validation
